title: aperiodic-autopoiesis-cell
description: The joint-quiescent corner H* = Fix(σ) ∩ Fix(Δ) of a commutative nuclear square (A, σ, Δ), taken together with σ and Δ themselves as part of the cell's content (the system carries its own producing-nuclei). At the aperiodic regime (κ ≥ ω_1), fiberwise variation of (σ_t, Δ_t) across histories makes the family of H*_t globally aperiodic. The cell's organization (the relation structure of H*) is invariant; its structure (the specific elements) is continuously replaced through fiberwise variation.
